issues.title: Differences between previous drafts from Christoph
issues.author: matttbe
issues.body:
From Yoshifumi Nishida on the [IETF Multipath ML](https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/multipathtcp/0ONo-LLAvxuJ10dYYS9YeyfNVL8/)

> As far as I remember we had draft-paasch-mptcp-application-authentication and draft-paasch-mptcp-ssl which address similar points. I think it would be great if the draft can address what's the difference between them and this draft and what's the advantages of this approach, etc.

issues.title: Explain why it is enough to store max two keys
issues.author: matttbe
issues.body:
From Yoshifumi Nishida on the [IETF Multipath ML](https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/multipathtcp/0ONo-LLAvxuJ10dYYS9YeyfNVL8/)

> 3: Why does it store just two keys? Or, does it mean it generates a new key when the next key is chosen and throws away the current key?

issues.title: NEW_KEY: limit retransmissions
issues.author: matttbe
issues.body:
From Yoshifumi Nishida on the [IETF Multipath ML](https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/msg/multipathtcp/qXcTQIAaH3ijjh7dP0xGkyQt64A/)

> I think a host that sends NEW_KEY option needs to give up resending it at some point.
> I think the draft needs to address this point.
